title: Venezuelan Empanada Jam Filling
description: A delicious and sweet filling for empanadas using a traditional venezuelan jam.
instructions: 2. Roll out empanada dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
3. Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
4. In a small bowl, mix together Venezuelan jam, molten chocolate chips, and quenched heavy cream.
5. Place a spoonful of the jam mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
6. Fold the other half of the dough circle over the filling to form a half-circle, pressing the edges to seal.
7. Brush the tops of the empanadas with confectioners' sugar.
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
